summary.en: Kogoro is hired by a beautiful woman named Mayako Nagamine, but after a call, when he meets her, she is found murdered in a park. Location: Kuraun Park Victim: Mayako Nagamine Cause of death: Stab wound on the abdomen Suspects: Haruhiko Nagamine The only suspect is Mayako's husband Haruhiko Nagamine, but it seems that the murder was't done by him. Another suspect named Ippei Aragaki is added and it seems he was in the scene before Haruhiko. Who is the real murderer?
